integration: asset scope denies foreign, stale, expired and raw requests before rendering
nested GET validates binding headers and scopes the private response to verified auth
client sends only binding metadata to the nested route with shared caching disabled
publicDto: maps source view field by field and excludes private root/nested data
strict public schema rejects extra fields at every nested object and sanitizes errors
strict public arrays reject balanced holes and extra metadata keys
public menu/dialog action projection excludes private markers and every nested object is strict
strict object schemas reject symbol and nonenumerable metadata as well as JSON extras
invalid internal output reports a sanitized contract error before any response or receipt
